notes: Keeps virtual-environment Python paths intact when launching the updater window.
Verifies the selected updater Python can import PySide6 before closing the main app.
Adds Python candidate and PySide6 probe diagnostics to updater launcher logs.
Shows a clear launch failure instead of closing the app when no GUI-capable Python is available.
Keeps update, rollback, offline bundle, firmware, device protocol, motion, and pressure-control behavior unchanged.
summary: Fixes updater window launch by preserving the virtual-environment Python path.
validation: Get-ChildItem releases\*.json | ForEach-Object { Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null }
